g.data-latex: \underset{\mathbf{x}_i, u_i}{\arg \min} \sum_{i=0}^{h-1} \left( \Delta \mathbf{x}_i ^\top \mathbf{V}^{(xx)}_i \Delta \mathbf{x}_i + V^{(uu)}_i \Delta u_i^2 + V^{(yy)}_i \Delta y_i^2\right) + \Delta \mathbf{x}_h ^\top \mathbf{V}^{(xx)}_h \Delta \mathbf{x}_h \\ \mathbf{M}_i \mathbf{x}_i + \mathbf{N}_i u_i \leq \mathbf{b}_i, \ \ \ \mathbf{M}_h \mathbf{x}_h \leq \mathbf{b}_h, \ \ \ 0 \leq i \leq h - 1.
